name: Fall On Luciferin
author: VampX
description:
Welcome to Fall On Luciferin, in this game you play as a glowing slime and the goal is to shoot down enemies and conquer the boss. Throughout this game the player uses a variety of weapons and faces a variety of enemies with their advanced AI as well as 10 UNIQUE levels including a boss. If you don't know how to play, there is a tutorial in-game. Enjoy!

My discord server with more of my games: https://discord.gg/MsRE8k4B
